Second Windows **beta** of Faraón (Farár / Prší), a test build. It fixes the Olympic modes and adds the new app icon.

## What's new

- **Olympic and Reverse Olympic: the round is now played to the end.** Before, a round stopped as soon as the first player finished, and the rest had to play a separate re-dealt shootout. Now everyone keeps playing in the same deal: the order in which players finish is the round's ranking, and the last player still holding cards loses the round. Scoring is unchanged:
  - Olympic: the loser gets one card fewer next round and is out at zero.
  - Reverse Olympic: the round winner sheds a card, and the first to reach zero wins the match.
  - If you finish early, **Fast-forward** (top right) speeds through the rest of the round.
- **New app icon** (the green unter on the card back) on the .exe files, and prepared for Android and iOS.

## Downloads

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| **Faraon-0.1.1-beta-PC.exe** | Desktop version. A 16:9 window sized to your screen. You can resize it freely; **F11** or **Alt+Enter** switches to fullscreen. |
| **Faraon-0.1.1-beta-Phone.exe** | Phone version for testing the mobile layout on a PC. A fixed **portrait** window shaped like a phone (19.5:9) that can't be resized or turned to landscape; the mouse works like a finger. |
| SHA256SUMS.txt | Checksums of the downloads. |

Both are single files: no install. Your progress from 0.1.0-beta carries over (same save folder, `%APPDATA%\Godot\app_userdata\Faraón`).

> **Windows SmartScreen:** the beta isn't code-signed. If you see "Windows protected your PC",
> click **More info → Run anyway**.

## Known limitations (unchanged)

- Multiplayer needs the game server, which isn't deployed yet.
- Ads and purchases are simulated: no real payment.

---

**SK:** Oprava olympijských režimov: kolo sa už nekončí prvým dohratým hráčom, ale **dohráva sa do konca** v tom istom rozdaní. Poradie dohratia určuje umiestnenia a prehráva posledný s kartami. Bodovanie ostáva rovnaké. Pribudla aj nová ikona aplikácie.
